definitions.explanation: A polite, indirect way of saying that someone has died, literally "going to the other world". Used of one's own family as well as of others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧{他界|たかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{他界|たかい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has been ten years since my father passed away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、{八十歳|はちじゅっさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{他界|たかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The author passed away at eighty without seeing the work completed.

notes:
REGISTER:
Gentler and more formal than ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧, and usable for one's own relatives (unlike ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧, which honors someone else's dead). Common in letters, speeches, news and biographies.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧: to die (plain, blunt)
- ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: to pass away (the usual polite word in conversation)
- ⟦{逝去|せいきょ}→逝去：14370_seikyo⟧: death of a respected person (honorific; not for one's own family)
- ⟦{永眠|えいみん}→永眠：32414_eimin⟧: eternal sleep (written, announcements)

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high, expensive); the accent differs and context makes it clear.
